name: Blue Hour Garden Gemstone Necklace
materials: Natural labradorite, ruby zoisite, jade, lapis; sterling silver accents, clasp, and chain
description: Labradorite’s shifting blue flashes meet the rich green and berry tones of ruby zoisite and jade in this one-of-a-kind, nature-inspired necklace. Sterling silver accents add a bright finish throughout, with sterling silver components completing the design. A colorful statement that still feels easy to wear.
